text:
Samira P.: opened a PR for a migration guide & snippets: dashboard presets + tracing hook rename + cost breakdown wording. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4810 :wave:
Ethan L.: nice. does the PR handle the metric key rename (cost_per_1k -> cost_per_k_tokens)? we changed that in runtime last week.
Marco: saw the PR, quick heads up: CI flagged a dead link in the migration guide section.
docs-ci-bot: build failed \u2014 1 broken link: /docs/console/metrics-legacy -> 404.
Samira P.: thanks, i'll update the link to /console/metrics/migration and add a redirect entry so old links keep working. also adding a short note on how quantized models can skew token costs.
Nadia: can we include a tiny Go snippet for the new tracing hook and a TypeScript example for fetching presets? ops teams ask for both.
Ethan L.: +1 on both snippets. for the TS snippet call it out as using SDK v2 methods (getPreset) so folks don't copy old code.
Samira P.: adding samples. Go snippet will show trace tagging + preset attach, TS will be minimal fetch + render callout. putting them in the migration guide under "Examples".
Samira P.: snippet drafts:
```go
// go 
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/v2"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
  preset, _ := client.Console.GetPreset("balanced")
  // attach trace tag so trace shows up in dashboard
  client.Traces.CreateTag("migration-run", "true")
  fmt.Println(preset.Name, preset.LatencyMs)
}
```
```ts
// ts (sdk v2)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
async function showPreset() {
  const p = await r.console.getPreset('balanced')
  renderCard({ title: p.name, medianLatencyMs: p.latency_ms, estCost: p.cost_per_k_tokens })
}
```
Ethan L.: tiny nit: go example ignores errors, add a comment that it's pseudo-code for docs. also prefer camelCase in TS snippet keys to match SDK shape.
Marco: can we also add a one-line migration checklist at top: 1) rename keys in query editor, 2) update dashboards to use new metric name, 3) add redirect for /docs/console/metrics-legacy. keeps things easy for infra.
Samira P.: good call. adding the checklist and a short compatibility note: "If you rely on quantized models, expect token cost variance; use the per-deployment benchmark numbers for SLAs."
Nadia: LGTM for content. can someone run the link-check locally before pushing? want to avoid another CI roundtrip.
Samira P.: i'll run linkcheck and lint, then push. tagging @Ethan for a quick copy pass after i push.
docs-ci-bot: build queued  re-run requested by Samira P.
Ethan L.: will look in ~15m. if CI passes, feel free to merge.
Samira P.: done, pushed fix and redirect added. thanks all — merging once CI green. :tada:
